note: Curated advisory inventory; runtime availability and suitability require verification. No model/solver capabilities are installed by this catalog.

capabilities.title: Requirements and unknowns extraction
capabilities.verification: Every requirement has provenance and acceptance criterion
capabilities.warning: Never hallucinate unstated business constraints

capabilities.title: Stakeholder question prioritizer
capabilities.baseline: Blocker vs nonblocker questions, grouped by decision impact
capabilities.verification: Each answered question changes explicit requirement or is marked no-impact
capabilities.warning: Do not ask questions already answered in provided files

capabilities.title: Agent task partition and handoff
capabilities.baseline: Owner files and stable contracts before parallel work
capabilities.verification: No overlapping writes, interface integration test
capabilities.warning: More agents may slow or conflict; count active workers

capabilities.title: Existing repository audit
capabilities.baseline: Read repo layout, docs, tests, locked dependencies
capabilities.upgrade: Minimal change plan with risk inventory
capabilities.verification: Baseline tests saved and diffs reviewed
capabilities.warning: Never overwrite unrelated work or guess Git remote

capabilities.title: Resumable session state
capabilities.verification: Cold-read resume test from state only
capabilities.warning: Do not claim a save occurred unless confirmed

capabilities.title: Time-budgeted delivery sizing
capabilities.baseline: Minimum vertical slice plus smoke test
capabilities.upgrade: High-value branches after first working result
capabilities.verification: Core use case demonstrable before polish
capabilities.warning: Do not sacrifice critical correctness for decoration

capabilities.title: Minimal static interface
capabilities.baseline: Vanilla JS with HTML/CSS and stable data interface
capabilities.upgrade: React or TypeScript when existing project supports it
capabilities.verification: Input, visible result, error, keyboard smoke
capabilities.warning: Static mock cannot claim backend functionality

capabilities.title: Component UI with state
capabilities.baseline: Use existing React setup and component tree
capabilities.verification: UI flow and state transition tests
capabilities.warning: Do not add build tooling if no requirement

capabilities.title: Python computation API
capabilities.baseline: Small FastAPI routes with typed data
capabilities.verification: 200/400/401/403/404/500 and schema contract
capabilities.warning: Dev server not production-grade authentication

capabilities.title: Node computation API
capabilities.baseline: Native Node HTTP or existing Express framework
capabilities.upgrade: Schema validation and typed route handlers
capabilities.verification: Invalid payload/error path and integration tests
capabilities.warning: Do not mix runtimes without a real boundary need

capabilities.title: Client-only deterministic calculator
capabilities.upgrade: Worker for heavy CPU with explicit cancellation
capabilities.verification: Property checks and consistent results
capabilities.warning: Do not place secrets or privileged rules client-side

capabilities.title: Role-based authorization
capabilities.verification: 401/403 checks on protected APIs independent of UI
capabilities.fallback: Preserve and verify the existing server-side authorization. If it cannot be implemented or executed, report NOT_RUN or BLOCKED; do not replace it with a mock UI.
capabilities.warning: Two login pages, a mock role UI, or a security demo do not establish real server authorization. A failed unauthorized-access check is FAIL, not a completed fallback.

capabilities.title: Cross-language input contracts
capabilities.baseline: Explicit JSON schema, reject invalid fields
capabilities.verification: Version ID unit/null/NaN/boolean tests
capabilities.warning: TypeScript types do not validate runtime JSON

capabilities.title: Local persistent records
capabilities.verification: Reopen persistence and concurrent write tests
capabilities.warning: Concurrent writes need transaction discipline

capabilities.title: Long operation progress
capabilities.verification: No hanging request; cancellation and retry
capabilities.warning: Never pretend a background job is complete

capabilities.title: Visual/interaction smoke testing
capabilities.verification: Input→API→calculation→render on real browser
capabilities.warning: Do not use GUI automation when competition forbids it

capabilities.title: Coordinate map and markers
capabilities.baseline: SVG coordinate overlay on local schematic
capabilities.verification: Coordinate bounds and click-to-ID mapping
capabilities.warning: External basemap network can be prohibited

capabilities.title: Exploratory data chart
capabilities.baseline: Plotly or static SVG with units
capabilities.verification: Axis units missing values and selection smoke
capabilities.warning: Chart polish cannot substitute data correctness

capabilities.title: Export consistent artifacts
capabilities.verification: Export re-import roundtrip and content comparison
capabilities.warning: Downloaded result must match visible UI state

capabilities.title: File inventory and schema profiling
capabilities.upgrade: Strict parsing with errors per file
capabilities.verification: Missing/encoding/empty/header test
capabilities.warning: No guessing of column semantics

capabilities.title: Multi-table joins and key checks
capabilities.baseline: Validate unique keys, cardinality and missing matches
capabilities.verification: Unmatched keys, join explosion, duplicates
capabilities.warning: Never silently inner-join away missing rows

capabilities.title: Missing/duplicate/outlier cleaning
capabilities.verification: Before/after counts and immutable raw source
capabilities.warning: Do not invent replacement values

capabilities.title: Nested JSON normalization
capabilities.baseline: Explicit flattening with full parent IDs
capabilities.verification: Roundtrip IDs and array multiplicity
capabilities.warning: Flattening may duplicate records

capabilities.title: Analytical SQL and grouping
capabilities.baseline: SQLite or DuckDB query with explicit grain
capabilities.verification: Conservation of counts, null semantics
capabilities.warning: SQL joins can inflate denominators

capabilities.title: Deterministic ETL pipeline
capabilities.verification: Repeat run equal hash, failure recovery
capabilities.warning: Do not mutate source data

capabilities.title: Local text search
capabilities.verification: Quoted evidence resolves to real source span
capabilities.warning: Search absence is not proof of absence

capabilities.title: Semantic document retrieval
capabilities.upgrade: Embeddings only if approved local model exists
capabilities.verification: Recall tests with relevant synthetic passages
capabilities.warning: External embedding API forbidden if cannot export data

capabilities.title: Nearest coordinate candidates
capabilities.upgrade: Road-network routing if supplied or permitted
capabilities.verification: Bounds, symmetry and coordinate sanity
capabilities.warning: Haversine not walk/driving network distance

capabilities.title: Spatial clustering
capabilities.baseline: Fixed radius groups with geographic units
capabilities.verification: Cluster stability and outlier tests
capabilities.warning: Coordinate degrees are not meters

capabilities.title: Graph modeling primitives
capabilities.verification: Reachability, duplicate node and asymmetric edges
capabilities.warning: Do not infer missing edges

capabilities.title: Unweighted shortest path
capabilities.verification: Path edge count versus exhaustive tiny graph
capabilities.warning: Use Dijkstra when weights differ

capabilities.title: Nonnegative weighted shortest path
capabilities.verification: Path connectivity and independently recomputed cost
capabilities.warning: Negative edges invalidate Dijkstra

capabilities.title: Shortest paths with negative edges
capabilities.verification: Negative-cycle case and finite path costs
capabilities.warning: Negative cycles mean no finite shortest path

capabilities.title: Maximum feasible flow
capabilities.verification: Capacity and flow conservation
capabilities.warning: Do not confuse min-cost and max-flow

capabilities.title: Capacitated allocation as min-cost flow
capabilities.verification: Supply/demand conservation and capacity
capabilities.warning: Requires correct graph construction and integrality

capabilities.title: One-to-one weighted assignment
capabilities.verification: One-to-one and cost oracle on small n
capabilities.warning: Do not apply one-to-one matching to capacities >1 directly

capabilities.title: Budget-constrained item selection
capabilities.verification: No budget excess and small exhaustive oracle
capabilities.warning: Ratio greedy not exact for 0/1 knapsack

capabilities.title: Nonoverlapping interval selection
capabilities.baseline: Earliest finish greedy if objective is max count
capabilities.verification: No overlaps and small exhaustive oracle
capabilities.warning: Greedy earliest finish fails for weighted case

capabilities.title: Precedence and critical path
capabilities.verification: Every prerequisite precedes dependent task
capabilities.warning: Topological sort alone does not optimize resources

capabilities.title: Resource-constrained scheduling
capabilities.verification: No overlap, time windows, capacity, precedence
capabilities.warning: Greedy schedule may have poor makespan

capabilities.title: Single route visit ordering
capabilities.verification: Each required stop visited once; exact small n DP
capabilities.warning: 2-opt reversing segment must recompute asymmetric edge costs

capabilities.title: Multi-vehicle capacity and time-window routes
capabilities.verification: All demands, vehicle loads, timing, route starts
capabilities.warning: Routing is not merely TSP; constraints may dominate

capabilities.title: Facility or pickup point selection
capabilities.verification: Facility-open link, capacity, coverage
capabilities.warning: Unserved demand should not silently disappear

capabilities.title: Linear continuous allocation
capabilities.verification: Primal constraints, duality gap/status if available
capabilities.fallback: Small corner enumeration only if tiny
capabilities.warning: Integer choices invalidate continuous relaxation as final answer

capabilities.title: Mixed discrete and continuous decisions
capabilities.verification: Integrality, constraints and solver status
capabilities.warning: Time limits can return feasible non-optimal solutions

capabilities.title: Combinatorial hard constraints
capabilities.verification: Independent rule checker + infeasible cases
capabilities.warning: CP-SAT integer scaling matters

capabilities.title: Improve an existing discrete solution
capabilities.verification: Monotonic objective if improvement-only; feasibility every move
capabilities.warning: Local optimum not global optimum

capabilities.title: Large nonconvex combinatorial search
capabilities.verification: Seed sweeps, wall-time, feasibility, baseline
capabilities.warning: Metaheuristic label does not prove better quality

capabilities.title: Quadratic binary encoding
capabilities.verification: Recover constraints and compare to MILP baseline
capabilities.warning: QUBO or quantum framing provides no automatic advantage

capabilities.title: Constrained smooth numerical optimization
capabilities.upgrade: Multistart, convexity check, KKT when applicable
capabilities.verification: Original constraints, gradients, termination code
capabilities.warning: Gradient method can converge to local stationary points

capabilities.title: Nonconvex or discontinuous objective
capabilities.verification: Seed stability, repeated trials and known synthetic optima
capabilities.warning: Black-box global solver usually lacks proof of global optimum

capabilities.title: Optimization under uncertain inputs
capabilities.baseline: Sensitivity sweep at a named nominal case
capabilities.verification: Feasible across specified scenario set
capabilities.warning: Invented distributions are not learned from data

capabilities.title: Stochastic decision problems
capabilities.baseline: Monte Carlo baseline with controlled seed
capabilities.verification: Empirical violation rate and CI on holdout draws
capabilities.warning: Sample in optimizer differs from independent evaluation draws

capabilities.title: Multiple objectives and trade-offs
capabilities.baseline: Single weighted scalar objective with explicit units
capabilities.verification: Dominance and sensitivity to scaling
capabilities.warning: Weighted sums can miss nonconvex Pareto regions

capabilities.title: Fairness and distribution of service
capabilities.verification: Distributional metric on original population
capabilities.warning: Average improvement may worsen worst-off group

capabilities.title: Supervised classification
capabilities.verification: Leakage-free split and confusion matrix, PR
capabilities.warning: Class imbalance makes accuracy misleading

capabilities.title: Continuous target prediction
capabilities.verification: MAE/RMSE on held-out data + residuals
capabilities.warning: Random train-test split invalid for time series

capabilities.title: Time-series forecasting
capabilities.verification: Walk-forward backtest, future-leak checks
capabilities.warning: Do not random shuffle time series

capabilities.title: Statistical inference
capabilities.verification: Sample unit, CI, effect size, multiple testing
capabilities.warning: P-value alone is not practical effect size

capabilities.title: Treatment-effect reasoning
capabilities.verification: Pretrends, confounders, placebo/sensitivity
capabilities.warning: Observational correlation is not causal identification

capabilities.title: Outlier or anomaly screening
capabilities.verification: Precision review and false-positive analysis
capabilities.warning: Without labels cannot claim anomaly detection accuracy

capabilities.title: Unsupervised group discovery
capabilities.verification: Stability, feature scaling, cluster utility
capabilities.warning: Cluster labels have no inherent semantic truth

capabilities.title: Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation
capabilities.baseline: Seeded Monte Carlo using documented distributions
capabilities.verification: Convergence, CI, sensitivity to assumptions
capabilities.warning: Synthetic priors must be labeled assumptions

capabilities.title: Bootstrap uncertainty interval
capabilities.verification: Coverage on synthetic known cases
capabilities.warning: Resample independent units, not arbitrary correlated rows

capabilities.title: Experiment design and power
capabilities.verification: Exposure unit, peeking and multiple comparisons
capabilities.warning: Post-hoc power not a substitute for design

capabilities.title: Annotate existing images
capabilities.baseline: Pillow shapes and labels on original
capabilities.verification: Bounding boxes inside image, original preserved
capabilities.warning: Annotated image is not an independent detection result

capabilities.title: Image alignment before comparison
capabilities.verification: Known transform synthetic test and residual
capabilities.warning: Do not call misalignment a defect

capabilities.title: Region segmentation
capabilities.verification: IoU on labeled synthetic masks
capabilities.warning: Threshold tuned on test image overfits

capabilities.title: Pixel geometry to physical measure
capabilities.verification: Known-size object and unit test
capabilities.warning: Pixel counts not physical length without calibration

capabilities.title: Compare reference and observed image
capabilities.baseline: Normalize exposure and register then diff
capabilities.verification: No-change/shift-only/real-change negative controls
capabilities.warning: Color/exposure changes can masquerade as damage

capabilities.title: Extract text from images
capabilities.baseline: Use provided selectable text if present
capabilities.upgrade: Local OCR binary if preinstalled & permitted
capabilities.verification: Spot-check OCR outputs and numeric tokens
capabilities.warning: OCR is not a reliable numeric oracle

capabilities.title: Create code-rendered diagram
capabilities.verification: Render and inspect visual output
capabilities.warning: Do not fabricate photographic evidence

capabilities.title: Symbolic equations and derivations
capabilities.verification: Residual, limits, units, independent example
capabilities.warning: Symbolic simplification may require assumptions

capabilities.title: Dimensional analysis
capabilities.verification: Reject dimensional mismatch and conversion tests
capabilities.warning: Numerically plausible answers can have wrong units

capabilities.title: Time evolution differential equations
capabilities.verification: Initial condition, residual, step convergence
capabilities.warning: Numerical success status alone not physical correctness

capabilities.title: Spatial fields and PDE models
capabilities.verification: Mesh refinement, boundary, conservation
capabilities.warning: Do not claim FEM reliability without mesh test

capabilities.title: Time-frequency signal processing
capabilities.verification: Nyquist, scaling, leakage and phase tests
capabilities.warning: FFT bins and Hz units must match sample rate

capabilities.title: Evidence-backed report
capabilities.verification: Trace every figure and number to source
capabilities.warning: Model-written claims without evidence are not facts

capabilities.title: PDF document extraction
capabilities.baseline: Use text layer extractor when available
capabilities.verification: Sample page spot-check and table numeric checks
capabilities.warning: Page order and tables may be scrambled

capabilities.title: Export files with correct typography
capabilities.verification: Open generated file, inspect figures/fonts
capabilities.warning: Do not claim PDF quality without visual inspection

capabilities.title: End-to-end use case coverage
capabilities.baseline: Happy path + empty invalid boundary cases
capabilities.verification: Manual browser and API result agree
capabilities.warning: Code unit tests do not prove UI interaction

capabilities.title: Independent solution verifier
capabilities.upgrade: Property tests and tiny exact oracle
capabilities.verification: Fault injection; catches deliberate invalid outputs
capabilities.warning: Three AI approvals are not three independent checks

capabilities.title: Fair baseline comparison
capabilities.verification: Wall-clock, objective, violations, timeout flags
capabilities.warning: Comparing different metrics is invalid

capabilities.title: Secret/data leak hygiene
capabilities.verification: No keys, private data or task content in public paths
capabilities.warning: Scanner cannot guarantee no leaks

capabilities.title: Environment and dependency checks
capabilities.upgrade: Minimal local install permitted by rules
capabilities.verification: Exact versions + import/run smoke
capabilities.warning: Do not assume install/runtime rights

capabilities.title: Crash recovery and idempotence
capabilities.baseline: Atomic state snapshot and rerun-safe commands
capabilities.upgrade: Job IDs and persisted state if needed
capabilities.verification: Repeat action does not double-write
capabilities.warning: A mere narrative status is not persistence

capabilities.title: Choose Docker vs direct runtime
capabilities.upgrade: Docker only if available and adds value
capabilities.verification: Same endpoints both modes if tested
capabilities.warning: Docker daemon may be missing or prohibited

capabilities.title: Choose MCP vs CLI utility
capabilities.upgrade: Local stdio MCP for repeatable typed calls
capabilities.verification: Same fixtures and result both interfaces
capabilities.warning: Tool wrappers do not increase algorithm accuracy

capabilities.title: Choose method based on problem properties
capabilities.verification: Selection rationale and contra-indications
capabilities.warning: Keyword-only selection can be confidently wrong

capabilities.title: Scientific reproducibility review
capabilities.baseline: Seed, assumptions and independent analytic case
capabilities.verification: Limit cases and conservation residual
capabilities.warning: Reproducibility does not prove truth
